cohort: All neonates (<28 days old) with permanent residency in any of the 17 cities within the West Azerbaijan province of Iran who died between 2013 and 2022.
finding: While West Azerbaijan province has achieved the SDG-3 target of reducing neonatal mortality to below 12 deaths per 1000 live births by 2030, significant disparities in neonatal mortality rate persist across the province, with perinatal prematurity being the leading cause of death.
